item.title: Amish Christmas Cookie Tour in Lancaster — Sat Nov 28 — Amish Farm and House
item.description: Interact with Amish families in their homes and learn about their heritage while sampling homemade cookies. This holiday season, make new friends, learn new recipes, and create memories to last a lifetime. Take a step away from the stress of the holidays, slow down, and let us take you on a relaxing and festive journey. We will visit three authentic Amish homes to sample homemade Christmas cookies. You’ll leave with an appreciation of another culture, along with recipes and cookies to take home and enjoy. Dad doesn’t need another tie, and Mom doesn’t want another gift card. Spend time with your loved ones this holiday season; join us for our Christmas cookie tour! IMPORTANT: Please indicate at the time of booking if you are traveling with another party, so that we can do our best to ensure you travel together. Our buses hold a maximum of 14 passengers. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Sat Nov 28, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Dominate the Storm: A Heart Pumping Evening with Reed Timmer, America's Most Famous Storm Chaser — Fri Jan 29, 7:30 PM — American Music Theatre
item.description: Tickets: $25 $30 $35 $45 Never Stop Chasing! Experience the raw power of nature through the eyes of Dr. Reed Timmer, extreme meteorologist, scientist, and one of the world’s most renowned storm chasers. With a PhD in meteorology from the University of Oklahoma, Reed has devoted his life to intercepting the planet’s most dangerous storms, collecting groundbreaking scientific data, and helping audiences better understand how severe weather is changing. Over the past several decades, Reed has intercepted more than 1,000 tornadoes and 50 hurricanes, including EF5 tornadoes and Category 5 hurricanes. He is also the inventor of the Dominators—armored, tank-like storm-chasing vehicles equipped with advanced meteorological sensors, hydraulic anchoring spikes, drones, probes, balloons, and even model rockets. item.title: LFS Monthly Discussion - El Serrano's — Wed Feb 3, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Lancaster Freethought Society Come joins us for intelligent discussion and freethinking fun at our monthly meeting. Lancaster Freethought Society is a community for Freethinkers, Atheists, Agnostics, Humanists, Non-believers, Skeptics, and those who are simply curious. There is no fee to attend our meetings which range from topical subjects of interest to freethinkers such as Church/State Separation, as well as subjects such as science, philosophy, ethics, counter-apologetics, and psychology. All are welcome to attend no matter what your beliefs may be but proselytizing is not allowed. Bring your articles, news, jokes, gripes, questions, ideas, topics, or anything else you would like to discuss with the rest of the group.
Hope to see you there!
Source: Meetup: Lancaster Freethought Society
